title: pharnaceum aurantium
intro: Pharnaceum aurantium, commonly known as bitter orange, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Pharnaceum aurantium include its ability to act as a nervine tonic, a sedative, and a carminative, providing relief from digestive issues and nervous system imbalances. The bioactive constituents of Pharnaceum aurantium include limonene, linalool, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
